correctness.rationale: Exact fixed-point Minkowski sum and its normal support formula reconstructed. The curvature radius is locally summable away from vertical and its divergence near vertical yields C2 via the graph slope. In the critical case head and tails are each bounded uniformly in N to get the exact logarithmic coefficient, not just numeric convergence. In the power-flat case the representation minimization is attained and Cauchy–Schwarz proves a two-sided estimate with explicit positive constants. Evenness and zero second derivative contradict C3 at the stated parameters. All quantifiers and range restrictions are explicit; finite checker is support, not an infinite proof.
